title: paramarthasara — param-p12-v104
question: Meditating this supreme brahman, briefly told by Abhinavagupta — soon indeed Śiva-ness enters own-heart-dwelling.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). Meditating this supreme brahman, briefly told by Abhinavagupta — soon indeed Śiva-ness enters own-heart-dwelling.

premises.text: viṣayeṣu sārvabhaumaḥ sarvajanaiḥ pūjyate yathā rājā | bhuvaneṣu sarvadaivair yogabhraṣṭas tathā pūjyaḥ mahatā kālena punar mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yogam abhyasya | prāpnoti divyam amṛtam yasmād āvartate na punaḥ tasmāt sanmārge 'smin nirato yaḥ kaścid eti sa śivatvam | iti matvā paramārthe yathā tathāpi prayatanīyam idam abhinavaguptoditasaṃkṣepaṃ dhyāyataḥ paraṃ brahma | acirād eva śivatvaṃ nijahṛdayāveśam abhyeti āryāśatena tad idaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstrasāram atigūḍham | abhinavaguptena mayā śivacaraṇasmaraṇadīptena
